title: An empty Fixed rules list still shows three sortable headers
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Location-A} has no fixed rules (for example a location where no part has a fixed price).
  • You are on a page other than Pricing and the Pricing Search box is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Pricing in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Fixed rules tab.
  3. Wait until the loading indicator on the Fixed rules tab disappears.
  4. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  5. Look at the three column headers.
  6. Look at the table body.
  7. Click the Category column header.
  8. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  9. Look at the three column headers.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: the Part Number, Category and Fixed Price headers are all shown.
  • Step 6: the table shows its usual empty-table message instead of rows.
  • Step 9: Category responds as a sortable column: it now shows an arrow pointing up, and the other two headers show none.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10136 (Story 3, Fixed Rules, sortable columns; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S3-N1 (with S3-R4), read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.4 (Fixed rules - before and after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N1: “If no fixed rules exist, the three column headers still render as sortable. The table shows its standard empty state.”
  • S3-R4: “When the user clicks a sortable column header that is not currently sorted, the list sorts by that column: A to Z for Part number and Category, highest first for Fixed price (S3-R8).”
